page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top. Main text in two columns of short index-like entries: a left column of topics with a right column of names beside them, both in lines of a list. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: Praefervationis ab omni-bus morbis, Hygeia: Servatius.
Curationis a morbis, Æsculapius: Raphaël Archang.
totius, scilicet Febri, Febris, ne noceat: Petronella.
Evulsionis dentium, Æsculapii Filii: doloris eorum,
ab Eryfipelate, qui ignis sacer, Antonius.

page.notes: Printed text is in two columns of short entries; the layout is reproduced as lines. Some words are uncertain in the scan's faded areas and the lines near the top-left and at "Thoracis" may be read imperfectly. Catchword "PATRO-" is printed at the foot and is given as a line.
